panels.explainHtml:
Trigger contrast. For one model, Δ = mean(triggered, last position) − mean(clean, last position) over the same 150 prompts: what adding “ butterflies” does to the final-token residual. The panel shows Δ(LoRA) − Δ(base), i.e. how much the LoRA changes the trigger's effect. Examples of each pair are below (clean, then triggered).
